title: AI-Assisted URL Vulnerability Scanner
summary: A URL-based vulnerability scanner and forensic report generator focused on OWASP Top 10 web security, automated threat detection, and header analysis.
overview: Developed a URL-based vulnerability scanner and security analyzer designed to probe web targets for security misconfigurations, insecure HTTP headers, injection vectors, and path traversal vulnerabilities.

title: UnivSafeNet – Student Database Management System
summary: A secure database application engineered for storing, updating, and retrieving university student records with parameterized queries and access control.
overview: UnivSafeNet is a robust student database management platform built to centralize student academic profiles, course registrations, and attendance metrics while maintaining strict data consistency.
